features: Recording resolution: no limits (depending on camera model)
Remote access via TRASSIR Client, Android/iOS app and TRASSIR Cloud; SSL encryption
Neural-network video analytics; up to 2 TRASSIR Neuro Detector channels (licenses included); other modules optional
8832R/64 INT has 32 and 8864R/64 INT has 64 licenses included to connect any cameras
Up to 2 monitors can be connected
notes: Video outputs left out: the datasheet gives 1 DisplayPort and 1 HDMI, the trassir.com product page gives D-SUB (VGA), DisplayPort and DVI-D.
